title: Certification-Based Differentially Private Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Differential privacy (DP) in machine learning is typically achieved by adding noise to model parameters (private learning) or to model outputs (private prediction). Recent work uses formal methods, namely abstract interpretation, to provide tighter privacy guarantees, but only for private prediction in classification settings. In this work, we investigate the use of formal methods as a general tool for tighter privacy analysis. First, we generalize the abstract gradient training (AGT) framework to private prediction in continuous, unbounded regression. Second, by reducing learning in parameterized models to a regression problem over the parameter space, we introduce Abstract Gradient Sampling (AGS), an algorithm that enables reachability-based analysis to provide guarantees for private learning. In both private prediction and private learning, we provide tightened privacy accounting for the AGT framework and a theoretical analysis demons

translated_title: 基于认证的差分隐私学习
translated_abstract: 机器学习中的差分隐私（DP）通常通过向模型参数添加噪声（私有学习）或向模型输出添加噪声（私有预测）来实现。近期的工作使用形式化方法，即抽象解释，来提供更紧密的隐私保证，但仅适用于分类场景下的私有预测。在这项工作中，我们研究将形式化方法作为一种通用工具来实现更紧密的隐私分析。首先，我们将抽象梯度训练（AGT）框架推广到连续、无界回归场景下的私有预测。其次，通过将参数化模型中的学习问题归约为参数空间上的回归问题，我们提出了抽象梯度采样（AGS）算法，该算法使基于可达性的分析能够为私有学习提供保证。在私有预测和私有学习两个方面，我们为AGT框架提供了更紧密的隐私核算以及相应的理论分析。
tldr: 该论文将形式化方法推广为更紧密差分隐私分析的通用工具，通过将抽象梯度训练（AGT）扩展到无界回归的私有预测，并提出抽象梯度采样（AGS）算法，首次使基于可达性的形式化分析能够为私有学习提供隐私保证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes formal methods as a general tool for tighter differential privacy analysis by extending Abstract Gradient Training (AGT) to private prediction in unbounded regression and introducing Abstract Gradient Sampling (AGS), an algorithm that enables reachability-based analysis to provide privacy guarantees for private learning.
